name: What preparation is needed before cabinet installers arrive?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before cabinet installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before cabinet installers arrive, it's crucial to have the installation area clear and ready. This typically involves removing old cabinets, clearing the space of personal items, and ensuring walls are free of obstructions and properly prepared for mounting. For projects in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, confirming that electrical outlets and plumbing connections are accurately roughed-in according to the new cabinet layout will prevent delays. We recommend discussing specific site readiness requirements during your initial consultation to ensure a smooth installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, clear the area, remove old cabinets, and ensure walls are free of obstructions. Confirm electrical and plumbing are roughed-in according to the new layout.
